sd_round_cooldown.description: Rounds between special days (wardens; admins with the rcon flag bypass).

sd_max_elapsed_time.description: Max seconds into a round a warden may still call a special day.

sd_gated_days.description: Days only players with sd_gate_flag (or root) may start; comma-separated day names, empty = none. Was the EdgeGamers Silver Supporter check.

sd_gate_flag.description: Admin flag that unlocks the gated days.

sd_gated_message.default: You must be a Silver Supporter to start this day.
sd_gated_message.description: Shown when a player lacks sd_gate_flag.

sd_ghost_visible_duration.description: Ghost War: seconds players are visible per cycle.

sd_ghost_invisible_duration.description: Ghost War: seconds players are hidden per cycle.

sd_noscope_weapon.description: No Scope: weapon(s) given to everyone, comma-separated.

sd_noscope_allowedweapons.description: No Scope: weapons players may pick up and fire, comma-separated; empty = no restriction.

sd_noscope_knife_delay.description: No Scope: seconds after setup until everyone gets a knife; 0 disables.

sd_noscope_gravity.description: No Scope: sv_gravity during the day (default game value is 800).

sd_oitc_weapon.description: One in the Chamber: the one-bullet weapon.

sd_oitc_additionalweapon.description: One in the Chamber: extra (non-ammo restricted) weapon; empty for none.

sd_hns_hide_hp_t.description: Hide and Seek: prisoner health during hide time; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_hide_hp_ct.description: Hide and Seek: guard health during hide time; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_hide_armor_t.description: Hide and Seek: prisoner armor during hide time; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_hide_armor_ct.description: Hide and Seek: guard armor during hide time; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_seek_hp_t.description: Hide and Seek: prisoner health once seeking starts.

sd_hns_seek_hp_ct.description: Hide and Seek: guard health once seeking starts.

sd_hns_seek_armor_t.description: Hide and Seek: prisoner armor once seeking starts; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_seek_armor_ct.description: Hide and Seek: guard armor once seeking starts; -1 = unchanged.

sd_hns_weapons_ct.description: Hide and Seek: weapons guards may pick up, comma-separated; empty = no restriction.

sd_hns_weapons_t.description: Hide and Seek: weapons prisoners may pick up, comma-separated; empty = no restriction.

sd_hns_seekers.description: Hide and Seek: the seeking team (restricted to the armory).

sd_hns_seektime.description: Hide and Seek: seconds the hiders get to hide.

rj_max_distance.description: Rocket Jump: max distance from the blast that still launches you.

rj_close_jump_distance.description: Rocket Jump: blasts closer than this give a full-force jump.

rj_jump_force_up.description: Rocket Jump: vertical boost per unit of closeness.

rj_jump_force_forward.description: Rocket Jump: scale when launched along your movement.

rj_jump_force_backward.description: Rocket Jump: scale when launched against your movement.

rj_run_force_main.description: Rocket Jump: multiplier when launched from the ground.

speedrun_initial_time.description: Speedrunners: seconds the runner gets to set the goal.

speedrun_first_round_freeze.description: Speedrunners: seconds to read the rules before the runner starts.

speedrun_win_time_base.description: Speedrunners: base seconds the winner gets to hunt the rest.

speedrun_win_time_bonus.description: Speedrunners: extra seconds per remaining competitor.

speedrun_win_max.description: Speedrunners: max seconds for the winner, regardless of bonus.

speedrun_win_weapons.description: Speedrunners: weapons given to the winner, comma-separated.

speedrun_loser_weapons.description: Speedrunners: weapons given to the losers, comma-separated.

speedrun_winner_damageable.description: Speedrunners: whether the winner can be damaged.

speedrun_loser_damageable.description: Speedrunners: whether the losers can be damaged.

speedrun_teleport_type.description: Speedrunners: at the end, 0 = no teleport, 1 = losers to the winner, 2 = winner to the losers.

speedrun_finish_at.description: Speedrunners: players left when a winner is declared.
